data.name: Tour.Welcome.Text
data.value: A few short steps through the main window: where your memories are, how to start one, and where to find the rest. Or add two example memories first and look around on your own.

data.name: Tour.Memories.Text
data.value: Each area of your life gets a memory of its own, so everything about it stays in one place. Collections keep track of things you own, such as clothes or a car; project memories hold projects with tasks, notes and files.

data.name: Tour.NewMemory.Text
data.value: A project memory is for plans and work, a collection for things you want to keep a record of. You can rename or delete either later with a right-click on it in the sidebar.

data.name: Tour.Todos.Text
data.value: Write down what needs doing and tick it off as you go. Home also shows the week with your reminders and calendar notes.

data.name: Tour.Corner.Text
data.value: Jot something down without leaving the page, get a Windows notification at the right time, even with TidyMind closed, or open the calendar. They work from every page.

data.name: Tour.Search.Text
data.value: Looks through every memory at once: projects, items, files, notebook pages and day plans. Ctrl+Shift+F opens it from any page.

data.name: Tour.End.Text
data.value: Memories, cards, tabs, tasks, files and calendar days have a right-click menu. Tips & shortcuts under the ? button lists them all, and the tour can be taken again from there.

data.name: Examples.WriteFailed
Hint.Cards
data.value: Right-click a card or an empty spot for more. Ctrl+click, Shift+click or dragging across empty space selects several cards.

data.name: Hint.Files
data.value: Right-click a file to rename it, show it in its folder or save a copy.

data.name: Hint.Notebook
data.value: Ctrl+PageUp and Ctrl+PageDown turn the page. In the ☰ list, Ctrl+click or Shift+click selects several pages.

data.name: Settings.BackgroundImage.Where
data.value: The picture itself is chosen on the memory's page: ⋯ at the top, then Edit Background.

data.name: WhatsNew.Points
data.value: Custom collections: in an empty collection, choose Custom when you add the first item, then build your own item page from blocks, such as fields, pictures, notes, checklists, documents with reminders, a log and quantities. Customize, on the item's page itself, adds, moves and renames blocks and fields, puts blocks side by side and picks up to three fields for the cards. The Day Plan shows the items' dates. Fixed: the first page of a new custom collection is now a real item, so pictures, checklist lines and everything else can be added right away.

data.name: Tips.Search.Text
data.value: Searches every memory: projects, items, files, notebook pages and day plans.

data.name: Tips.QuickNote.Text
data.value: Opens Quick Notes, a scratch pad that saves what you typed when you close it.

data.name: Tips.Undo.Text
data.value: Undoes the last change on the page: a delete, a tick, a rename, a move or a saved edit. In a text box it undoes your typing instead.

data.name: Tips.RightClick.Text
data.value: Opens a menu on memories, cards, tabs, tasks, files, to-dos, calendar days, plan blocks and reminders.

data.name: Tips.Escape.Text
data.value: Closes search, the calendar, Quick Notes and windows such as Project details. While you edit a text in place, it puts the old text back.

data.name: Tips.MemoryMenu.Text
data.value: Rename, delete or export it, add a reminder, or export a collection for transfer to another PC. The ⋯ button at the top of its page has the same menu.

data.name: Tips.MemoryDrag.Text
data.value: Moves it up or down within its group.

data.name: Tips.MemorySelect.Text
data.value: Selects several memories. Delete deletes them after one question; Esc clears the selection.

data.name: Tips.CardMenu.Text
data.value: The card's menu: rename or edit, delete, add a reminder, export (also for transfer), copy the name. A project card can also get a color or picture of its own.

data.name: Tips.CardSelect.Text
data.value: Selects several cards. Then Ctrl+A selects all of them on the tab, and Delete deletes them after one question.

data.name: Tips.Marquee.Text
data.value: Selects every card the frame touches. Hold Ctrl to add to the selection.

data.name: Tips.CardDrag.Text
data.value: Moves it to another place on the tab.

data.name: Tips.Background.Text
data.value: Edit Background: a color or a picture behind the page. Also in the ⋯ menu at the top of the page.

data.name: Tips.TabMenu.Text
data.value: Rename or delete it. When a tab is deleted, its cards move to another tab; nothing is lost.

data.name: Tips.TabDrag.Text
data.value: Changes the order of the tabs.

data.name: Tips.TodoFold.Keys
data.value: Click TO-DO on a project memory's page

data.name: Tips.TodoFold.Text
data.value: Folds the to-do list to one line that shows the next to-do.

data.name: Tips.TaskSelect.Text
data.value: Selects several tasks or files. Delete removes them; Ctrl+C copies the tasks' text.

data.name: Tips.FileMenu.Text
data.value: Open it, show it in its folder, save a copy, rename or remove it.

data.name: Tips.FileDrop.Text
data.value: Attaches them to the project. They are copied into TidyMind's data folder.

data.name: Tips.ProjectEscape.Text
data.value: Saves and closes Project details, as Save does. An open page list closes first.

data.name: Tips.PageTurn.Text
data.value: Turns to the previous or next page. Past the last page a new one starts, unless the last one is still empty.

data.name: Tips.PageSelect.Text
data.value: Selects several pages in the page list to delete them together. Deleting every page leaves page 1, emptied.

data.name: Tips.Format.Text
data.value: Bold, italic and underline in a description or a notebook page. Text color is on the toolbar and in the right-click menu.

data.name: Tips.Paste.Text
data.value: Text copied from another program comes in as plain text; formatting copied inside TidyMind is kept.

data.name: Tips.TodoAdd.Text
data.value: Adds the to-do you typed. Esc empties the box.

data.name: Tips.TodoSelect.Text
data.value: Selects several to-dos. Delete deletes them.

data.name: Tips.WeekDay.Keys
data.value: Click a date in Home's week

data.name: Tips.WeekDay.Text
data.value: Opens that day in the calendar. Right-click a reminder or a note in the week to edit or delete it.

data.name: Tips.CalendarDay.Keys
data.value: Right-click a day in the calendar

data.name: Tips.CalendarDay.Text
data.value: Adds a reminder for that day (today or later). A click opens the day for its color, note and plan.

data.name: Tips.DialogSave.Text
data.value: Saves a calendar day or a plan block in its window.

data.name: Tips.PlanCreate.Text
data.value: Plans a new block for those times.

data.name: Tips.PlanMove.Keys
data.value: Drag a block, or its top or bottom edge

data.name: Tips.PlanMove.Text
data.value: Moves it, or changes when it starts or ends, in steps of 15 minutes.

data.name: Tips.PlanTodo.Keys
data.value: Drag a to-do onto the timeline

data.name: Tips.PlanSelect.Text
data.value: Selects several blocks. Delete deletes them.

data.name: Tips.ItemSearch.Text
data.value: In a vehicle's window, finds any field, record or log entry.

data.name: Tips.ItemPictures.Text
data.value: Browses an item's pictures in its window.

data.name: Tips.ItemEscape.Text
data.value: In an item's window: empties the search, stops an edit (asking if something changed), or closes the window.

data.name: Tips.PictureDrag.Keys
data.value: Drag a picture in the item form

data.name: Tips.PictureDrag.Text
data.value: Changes the order of the pictures. The first one is the cover.

data.name: Checklist.Project.Text
data.value: New Project in the sidebar makes a project memory; Add Project on its page adds a project to it.

data.name: Checklist.Task.Text
data.value: Open a project and type the task under Tasks.

data.name: Checklist.Reminder.Text
data.value: The 🔔 button in the corner opens your reminders, and many right-click menus have Add Reminder. It arrives as a Windows notification.

data.name: Checklist.Item.Title
data.value: Add an item to a collection

data.name: Checklist.Item.Text
data.value: Click New Collection in the sidebar, then Add item on its page.

data.name: Custom.Layout.NotCreated
data.value: The layout couldn't be saved to {0}. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Entity.Records.CustomDocuments.Empty
data.value: No documents yet. Add one with the date it runs out: it shows on the card and on Home, and you can be reminded in time.

data.name: Entity.Records.CustomQuantities.Empty
data.value: Nothing listed yet. Add what there is and how much.

data.name: Custom.Item.NoBlocks
data.value: This layout has no blocks yet.

data.name: Custom.Layout.Hint
data.value: Changes apply to every item in this collection. Ctrl+Z undoes them.

data.name: Custom.Customize.Tip
data.value: Change the page every item of this collection has: its blocks, fields and their order.

data.name: Custom.Layout.Start
data.value: This is the page every item in this collection will have. Add what it should hold.

data.name: Custom.Layout.SaveFailed
data.value: The layout couldn't be saved to {0}. It is as it was.

data.name: Custom.Layout.RemoveData.One
data.value: Remove “{1}”? {0} item has something in it, which will be deleted with it. You can undo this.

data.name: Custom.Layout.RemoveData.Other
data.value: Remove “{1}”? {0} items have something in it, which will be deleted with it. You can undo this.

data.name: Custom.Kind.Fields.Text
data.value: Text, numbers, dates, yes/no and choices

data.name: Custom.Kind.Documents.Text
data.value: Documents with the date they run out, and a reminder

data.name: Custom.Kind.Quantities.Text
data.value: What there is and how much

data.name: Custom.Field.CardFull
data.value: A card shows at most 3 fields.

data.name: Transfer.Import.AddsLayout
data.value: “{0}” has no layout for custom items yet: it gets one, with the blocks this item uses.

data.name: Transfer.Import.AddsBlocks
data.value: The blocks it uses that “{0}” doesn't have yet are added to that collection's layout.

data.name: Plan.ItemDatesHint
data.value: On this day. Click one to open its item.

data.name: Tips.CustomLayout.Text
data.value: Changes the page of a collection's Custom items where it is: blocks and fields added, moved, renamed or removed, half or full width. Its clothing and vehicles stay as they are.

data.name: Tips.ChecklistSelect.Text
data.value: Selects several lines of an item's checklist. Delete deletes them.

data.name: Custom.Layout.CantRead
data.value: The layout couldn't be read from {0}, so it can't be changed now. Nothing was changed.

data.name: Custom.Layout.NotPutBack
data.value: The items couldn't be saved, and the layout couldn't be put back as it was in {0}. Ctrl+Z puts it back once the file can be written.

data.name: Custom.Layout.KindUnfit.One
data.value: Change “{1}” to {2}? In {0} item its value can't be read as that and will be removed. You can undo this.

data.name: Custom.Layout.KindUnfit.Other
data.value: Change “{1}” to {2}? In {0} items its value can't be read as that and will be removed. You can undo this.

data.name: Entity.Type.Custom.Text
data.value: Build your own layout from blocks.

data.name: Entity.Type.Clothing.Text
data.value: Garments with sizes, material and season.

data.name: Entity.Type.Vehicle.Text
data.value: Documents, service log, wheels and parts.
